notes.text: The authors report probing syntax in three pretrained encoders with linear and MLP probes, using sentences from an automatically parsed corpus (Abstract). They state that syntactic information peaks in the middle layers, and that probe accuracy drops by 4–9% when control tasks are used (Section 1). They further report that larger encoders show the same layer pattern, and that probe capacity changes accuracy by less than 2% across settings (Section 4).
